relationships.subject: ACC-projecting claustrum neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These results establish the existence of a tonic excitatory influence of the claustrum on the ACC, which is lost at 1 week of inflammatory pain.

relationships.subject: ACC-projecting claustrum neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: suppression of CLAACC activity acutely attenuates allodynia

relationships.subject: inflammatory pain allodynia
relationships.evidence_quote: the number of open AMPA channels was significantly lowered compared with saline controls

key_findings: Chemogenetic suppression of claustrum-to-ACC neurons attenuates CFA allodynia acutely, and claustral excitatory drive onto ACC is lost after one week of pain.
One week of inflammatory pain reduces AMPA-mediated efficacy onto L5 ACC pyramidal neurons and facilitates local inhibition.
